meanings.en: the act of finding the way to a place by sea, air, or land
meanings.exampleEn: Modern navigation relies heavily on satellite systems.
meanings.exampleTr: Modern seyrüsefer büyük ölçüde uydu sistemlerine dayanır.

meanings.en: the part of a country's armed forces that fights at sea
meanings.exampleEn: He joined the navy when he was eighteen.
meanings.exampleTr: On sekiz yaşındayken donanmaya katıldı.

meanings.en: tidy and carefully arranged
meanings.exampleEn: Her desk is always neat and well organized.
meanings.exampleTr: Masası her zaman düzenli ve iyi organize edilmiştir.

meanings.en: as a necessary or unavoidable result
meanings.exampleEn: A high price does not necessarily mean high quality.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüksek fiyat mutlaka yüksek kalite anlamına gelmez.

meanings.en: the fact of being needed or essential
meanings.exampleEn: Water is a basic necessity for all living things.
meanings.exampleTr: Su, tüm canlılar için temel bir gerekliliktir.

meanings.en: not needed or necessary
meanings.exampleEn: The delay caused needless worry to the passengers.
meanings.exampleTr: Gecikme, yolcular için gereksiz endişeye yol açtı.

meanings.en: not having enough money, food, or other basic things
meanings.exampleEn: The charity collects clothes for needy families.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayır kurumu muhtaç aileler için giysi toplar.

meanings.en: in a harmful, unfavorable, or pessimistic way
meanings.exampleEn: The bad weather affected the harvest negatively.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü hava hasadı olumsuz biçimde etkiledi.

meanings.en: failure to give proper care or attention to something
meanings.exampleEn: The old house had fallen into ruin through years of neglect.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski ev, yıllarca süren ihmal yüzünden harabeye dönmüştü.

meanings.en: located near or next to a particular place
meanings.exampleEn: People came from neighboring towns to see the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar festivali görmek için komşu kasabalardan geldi.

meanings.tr: ne ... ne de; o da değil
meanings.en: used to show that a negative statement is also true of someone or something else
meanings.exampleEn: She does not like coffee, and neither do I.
meanings.exampleTr: O kahve sevmez, ben de sevmem.

meanings.en: a fiber that carries messages between the brain and the body
meanings.exampleEn: The injury damaged a nerve in his arm.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaralanma, kolundaki bir siniri zedeledi.

meanings.en: a feeling of worry or anxiety before an event
meanings.exampleEn: She suffered from nerves before the big exam.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük sınavdan önce gerginlikten muzdaripti.

meanings.en: in an anxious or worried manner
meanings.exampleEn: He waited nervously for the results of the test.
meanings.exampleTr: Testin sonuçlarını tedirginlikle bekledi.

meanings.en: a person who browses the internet for pleasure or information
meanings.exampleEn: As a keen netsurfer, she spends hours exploring new websites.
meanings.exampleTr: Hevesli bir net gezgini olarak yeni web sitelerini keşfederek saatler geçirir.

meanings.en: a mental condition involving excessive anxiety or obsessive behavior
meanings.exampleEn: The therapist helped him cope with his neurosis.
meanings.exampleTr: Terapist, nevrozuyla başa çıkmasına yardım etti.

meanings.en: a person who reads the news on television or radio
meanings.exampleEn: The newscaster reported the breaking story calmly.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber spikeri, son dakika haberini sakince aktardı.

meanings.en: interesting or important enough to be reported as news
meanings.exampleEn: The scientist's discovery was considered highly newsworthy.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanının keşfi son derece haber değeri taşıyan kabul edildi.

meanings.en: in a pleasant, satisfactory, or skillful way
meanings.exampleEn: The room was nicely decorated for the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda parti için güzelce dekore edilmişti.

meanings.en: a place open at night where people go to dance and drink
meanings.exampleEn: They danced until dawn at a popular nightclub.
meanings.exampleTr: Popüler bir gece kulübünde şafağa kadar dans ettiler.

meanings.en: a frightening dream, or a very unpleasant experience
meanings.exampleEn: The traffic on the way home was an absolute nightmare.
meanings.exampleTr: Eve dönüş yolundaki trafik tam bir kâbustu.

meanings.en: the people of the highest social class, or the quality of being noble
meanings.exampleEn: Members of the nobility once owned vast estates.
meanings.exampleTr: Soylular sınıfının üyeleri bir zamanlar geniş arazilere sahipti.

meanings.en: having or showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles
meanings.exampleEn: Helping the poor was a noble act of kindness.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoksullara yardım etmek asil bir iyilik eylemiydi.

meanings.en: a man who belongs to the highest social class
meanings.exampleEn: The nobleman owned a large castle in the countryside.
meanings.exampleTr: Asilzade, kırsalda büyük bir şatoya sahipti.

meanings.en: a member of a group that moves from place to place rather than settling
meanings.exampleEn: The desert nomads traveled with their camels and tents.
meanings.exampleTr: Çöl göçebeleri develeri ve çadırlarıyla seyahat ettiler.

meanings.en: the act of officially suggesting someone for a position or prize
meanings.exampleEn: The film received a nomination for best picture.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, en iyi film dalında bir adaylık aldı.

meanings.en: a person who has been officially suggested for a position or award
meanings.exampleEn: Each nominee gave a short speech at the ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Her aday törende kısa bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: where smoking is not allowed
meanings.exampleEn: We asked for a table in the non-smoking section.
meanings.exampleTr: Sigara içilmeyen bölümde bir masa istedik.

meanings.en: not done as a paid job or not having professional training
meanings.exampleEn: The tournament was open to nonprofessional players only.
meanings.exampleTr: Turnuva yalnızca profesyonel olmayan oyunculara açıktı.

meanings.en: toward the north
meanings.exampleEn: The birds flew northward as summer approached.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaz yaklaşırken kuşlar kuzeye doğru uçtu.

meanings.en: one of the two openings at the end of the nose
meanings.exampleEn: He breathed in deeply through one nostril.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir burun deliğinden derin bir nefes aldı.

meanings.en: the number zero (British English)
meanings.exampleEn: The temperature dropped to nought degrees overnight.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcaklık gece boyunca sıfır dereceye düştü.

meanings.en: to provide with the food and substances needed to grow and stay healthy
meanings.exampleEn: A balanced diet helps to nourish the body.
meanings.exampleTr: Dengeli bir beslenme vücudu beslemeye yardımcı olur.

meanings.en: the food and substances necessary for growth and health
meanings.exampleEn: Babies get all their nourishment from milk at first.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebekler başlangıçta tüm besinlerini sütten alır.

meanings.en: the quality of being new, original, or unusual
meanings.exampleEn: The novelty of the new phone soon wore off.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni telefonun yeniliği kısa sürede tükendi.

meanings.en: a person or thing that causes trouble or annoyance
meanings.exampleEn: The constant noise from the street is a real nuisance.
meanings.exampleTr: Sokaktan gelen sürekli gürültü gerçek bir baş belası.

meanings.en: relating to or expressed as numbers
meanings.exampleEn: The data was arranged in numerical order.
meanings.exampleTr: Veriler sayısal sıraya göre düzenlenmişti.

meanings.en: a place where young children are cared for, or where plants are grown
meanings.exampleEn: She leaves her son at the nursery before going to work.
meanings.exampleTr: İşe gitmeden önce oğlunu kreşe bırakıyor.

meanings.en: a hard-shelled fruit with an edible kernel, or a metal piece that screws onto a bolt
meanings.exampleEn: He tightened the nut on the wheel with a wrench.
meanings.exampleTr: Tekerlekteki somunu bir anahtarla sıktı.

meanings.en: the hard outer covering of a nut; used in 'in a nutshell' to mean briefly
meanings.exampleEn: In a nutshell, the project was a great success.
meanings.exampleTr: Kısacası, proje büyük bir başarıydı.

meanings.en: a formal and serious promise
meanings.exampleEn: The witness took an oath to tell the truth.
meanings.exampleTr: Tanık, gerçeği söyleyeceğine dair yemin etti.

meanings.en: the act of doing what you are told to do
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers showed complete obedience to their commander.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler komutanlarına tam bir itaat gösterdiler.

meanings.en: willing to do what you are told to do
meanings.exampleEn: The obedient dog sat down when told.
meanings.exampleTr: İtaatkâr köpek, söylenince oturdu.

meanings.en: to do what you are told or required to do
meanings.exampleEn: Drivers must obey the speed limit.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürücüler hız sınırına uymak zorundadır.

meanings.en: a notice of a person's death, usually with a short account of their life
meanings.exampleEn: Her obituary appeared in the local newspaper.
meanings.exampleTr: Ölüm ilanı yerel gazetede yayımlandı.

meanings.en: something you must do because of a law, promise, or duty
meanings.exampleEn: Parents have an obligation to care for their children.
meanings.exampleTr: Ebeveynlerin çocuklarına bakma yükümlülüğü vardır.

meanings.en: a person who watches something carefully
meanings.exampleEn: An independent observer monitored the election.
meanings.exampleTr: Bağımsız bir gözlemci seçimi izledi.

meanings.en: to think about something constantly and uncontrollably
meanings.exampleEn: She tends to obsess over small mistakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük hataları kafasına takma eğilimindedir.

meanings.en: a state in which someone thinks about something all the time
meanings.exampleEn: His obsession with football affects his studies.
meanings.exampleTr: Futbola olan saplantısı derslerini etkiliyor.

meanings.en: thinking about something too much in a way that is not healthy
meanings.exampleEn: He has an obsessive need to keep everything clean.
meanings.exampleTr: Her şeyi temiz tutma konusunda takıntılı bir ihtiyacı var.

meanings.en: strange or unusual; or not divisible by two
meanings.exampleEn: It was odd that nobody answered the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapıyı kimsenin açmaması tuhaftı.

meanings.en: to make someone upset or angry by what you say or do
meanings.exampleEn: I did not mean to offend you with my comment.
meanings.exampleTr: Yorumumla seni gücendirmek istemedim.

meanings.en: a person who commits a crime or breaks a rule
meanings.exampleEn: Repeat offenders may face longer sentences.
meanings.exampleTr: Mükerrer suçlular daha uzun cezalarla karşılaşabilir.

meanings.en: a crime or illegal act; or the feeling of being upset
meanings.exampleEn: Driving without a license is a serious offense.
meanings.exampleTr: Ehliyetsiz araç kullanmak ciddi bir suçtur.

meanings.en: without preparation or time to think
meanings.exampleEn: I cannot tell you the exact figure offhand.
meanings.exampleTr: Tam rakamı hemen, düşünmeden söyleyemem.

meanings.tr: açık deniz, kıyıdan uzakta; deniz aşırı
meanings.en: located in or relating to the sea away from the coast
meanings.exampleEn: The company built an offshore wind farm.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket açık denizde bir rüzgar çiftliği kurdu.

meanings.en: a smooth substance that you rub on the skin to heal it
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor gave her an ointment for the rash.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor, döküntü için ona bir merhem verdi.

meanings.en: a small bitter fruit used for food and oil
meanings.exampleEn: She added a few olives to the salad.
meanings.exampleTr: Salataya birkaç zeytin ekledi.

meanings.en: an ancient site in Greece where the original Olympic Games were held
meanings.exampleEn: Tourists visit Olympia to see the ruins of the ancient stadium.
meanings.exampleTr: Turistler antik stadyumun kalıntılarını görmek için Olympia'yı ziyaret eder.

meanings.en: a staging of the Olympic Games, or a major competition
meanings.exampleEn: She won a medal at the international mathematics Olympiad.
meanings.exampleTr: Uluslararası matematik olimpiyatında bir madalya kazandı.

meanings.en: without trying to hide your feelings or actions
meanings.exampleEn: They spoke openly about their plans for the future.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelecek planları hakkında açıkça konuştular.

meanings.en: a person who operates equipment or connects telephone calls
meanings.exampleEn: The machine operator checked the controls carefully.
meanings.exampleTr: Makine operatörü kumandaları dikkatlice kontrol etti.

meanings.en: a person who competes against or opposes another
meanings.exampleEn: She defeated her opponent in the final match.
meanings.exampleTr: Finalde rakibini yendi.

meanings.en: the tendency to expect good things to happen
meanings.exampleEn: Despite the difficulties, she faced the future with optimism.
meanings.exampleTr: Zorluklara rağmen geleceğe iyimserlikle baktı.

meanings.en: a person who tends to expect good outcomes
meanings.exampleEn: As an optimist, he always sees the bright side of things.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir iyimser olarak her zaman işlerin iyi yanını görür.

meanings.en: hopeful and expecting good things to happen
meanings.exampleEn: The doctors are optimistic about her full recovery.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar onun tam iyileşmesi konusunda iyimser.

meanings.en: available to be chosen but not required
meanings.exampleEn: The evening trip is optional and costs extra.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam gezisi isteğe bağlıdır ve ekstra ücretlidir.

meanings.en: spoken rather than written; or relating to the mouth
meanings.exampleEn: Students must pass an oral exam in French.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler Fransızcada sözlü bir sınavı geçmek zorunda.

meanings.en: a person who is skilled at public speaking
meanings.exampleEn: The senator was a brilliant orator who moved the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Senatör, kalabalığı etkileyen parlak bir hatipti.

meanings.en: relating to or written for an orchestra
meanings.exampleEn: The film features a powerful orchestral score.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, güçlü bir orkestral müziğe sahip.
